name: DragonMsg
meaning: Dragon_HandleMessage 0x447e10 (all from TimeMachineSphere: the Dragon is its follower slot +0x218)

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_CALL
meaning: arg = &sphere pos, sent when the Wolf enters the sphere's +-185 cube. Within 499 (3-D), or flying and within 999: approach (0x1b/0x15/0x21/0x22), returns 1. Else saves the state, waits (0x23/0x24), returns 0.

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_LOCK
meaning: Follower reached the sphere cube: box collision off, warp anim (0x1c/0x1d), returns 1.

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_ARRIVE
meaning: arg = translated arrival point: collision on, SetPosition, state 0x1f, returns 1.

name: MSG_TIMEMACHINE_RELEASE
meaning: The sphere's 3000-ms follower wait expired: SetState(0) (even in the air), returns 0.
